newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Ballarat rejects GPG's takeover bid.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Ballarat rejects GPG's takeover bid.

text.p: Ballarat Brewing Co Ltd said on Monday its directors unanimously rejected the A$2.45 per share full takeover bid launched by Guinness Peat Group Ltd.
"Your Directors have met to consider GPG's new takeover offer and recommend unanimously that it be rejected by shareholders," Ballarat said.

It said a more detailed explanation of the reasons for your Directors' recommendation will be outlined in the company's formal Part B statement which will be dispatched as soon as practicable after GPG have sent the Part A statement and offer documents to shareholders.
GPG revised its orginal partial takeover bid for Ballarat to the current full takeover bid on September 20. Ballarat rejected GPG's partial offer.
GPG is controlled by New Zealand businessman Sir Ron Brierley.
At 10.20 a.m. (0020 GMT), Ballarat were untraded from the A$2.46 close on Friday, which was unchanged on the day.
